title: X-QLUSIVE BLUERAZZ – 2500 PUFFS
description:
X-QLUSIVE BLUERAZZ – 2500 PUFFS

X-QLUSIVE BLUERAZZ BLUERAZZ (XQLUSIVE) Disposable vape is designed as a disposable device for leisure vaping, made of light SS material & providing a comfortable hand feeling. Each device contains 7.5ml e-liquid, with a battery of 1100mAh to keep the device running up to 2500 puffs.
